swap.title: NFT Swap
swap.subtitle: Both sides deposit items, confirm, then atomic swap. Whitelisted contracts only — on-chain proof, no fake images.
swap.security1: Only platform-registered collection contracts are allowed
swap.security2: ownerOf must match your connected wallet when adding
swap.security3: Images come from tokenURI metadata — no user uploads
swap.security4: Deposit escrow: transfer only agreed NFTs, no collection-wide approval; atomic swap when both deposit
swap.counterpartyHint: Share the room link. They can see your slots live and chat in the room.
swap.escrowPending: Escrow contract not configured: room sync and chat work now; set NEXT_PUBLIC_SWAP_CONTRACT after deploy for one-click settlement.
swap.createWithoutWallet: Create a room without wallet; connect before adding NFTs or confirming.
swap.executeHint: Both sides confirmed — approve escrow and execute atomic swap on-chain
swap.insufficientPoints: Not enough points — deposit costs {fee} pts. Claim in the hall first.
swap.depositHint: Both confirmed — transfer your slotted NFTs into the escrow contract
swap.depositAtomicNote: No collection-wide approval. When both sides deposit, the contract swaps atomically in one transaction.
swap.withdrawHint: Reclaim your NFTs if counterparty does not deposit within 10 minutes
swap.deadlineWaitingYou: Counterparty deposited — deposit yours before timeout
swap.deadlineExpiredHint: Click below to reclaim your NFTs
swap.waitMakerFirst: Wait for the room creator to deposit on-chain first
swap.swapCancelled: Swap cancelled — you can place NFTs and confirm again
swap.executeFailed: Transaction failed — check approvals and network
swap.chatSendFailed: Failed to send — refresh and try again
swap.chatWithoutWallet: Chat works without a wallet. Connect only to add NFTs or execute the swap.
swap.verifyHint: We query Ethereum mainnet for ownerOf and tokenURI. Only verified tokens enter slots.
swap.flow1: Both users join the same swap room
swap.flow4: After UI confirm, each party signs deposit txs to escrow
swap.flow5: Atomic swap when both deposit; 10-minute countdown after first deposit, reclaim on timeout
swap.errNotOwner: This NFT is not in the connected wallet — switch account

quant.title: Quant Strategy Tool
quant.subtitle: Neutral software: public on-chain DEX data, rule templates, backtest, local paper mode. You configure APIs/AI; we do not give investment advice or connect to gambling/prediction markets.
quant.quickTagline: Pick coin → pick rule → paper trade. Live later.
quant.templateScopeNotice: Introductory rule templates only — not a complete quant system; quant is far more than these three ideas.
quant.autoTradeHow: When running: your browser fetches public market data about every 45s, applies your fixed params with simple formulas, and paper-trades only on buy/sell signals. Params do not auto-tune; no AI compute required — keep this tab open.
quant.quickIntro: Virtual $10,000 auto-trades by your rules. No real money. Go live only when you wire your own wallet/API.
quant.paperPreviewIntro: [Paper preview] Virtual $10,000 to try rules and signals. Keep this tab open — closing stops the run. For real trades use the Live tab (in development).
quant.paperPreviewNote: Paper mode is not real P&L and is not a substitute for live testing.
quant.cloudRunningHint: Cloud running · checks ~every 5 min · tab can close
quant.cloudNeedWallet: Connect wallet and sign in to use cloud paper.
quant.cloudKvMissing: Cloud storage not ready — bind SWAP_KV and Cron on Cloudflare (see docs).
quant.cloudActionFailed: Action failed — re-sign or try later.
quant.cloudIntro: [Cloud paper] Virtual $10,000 on Cloudflare; scheduled ticks run your rules. Tab can close; wallet required.
quant.cloudUiNote: Coin pick applies on restart; live stats use cloud config
quant.strategyIntroHint: Tap a strategy name to view rule details (not investment advice).
quant.liveIntro: Planned: BSC / Ethereum DEX swaps with wallet signatures (you pay gas), or your own exchange API. Every trade requires your approval; we never custody funds or keys.
